$comment: What each task needs on each OS. build/lib/prerequisites.ts checks it (npm run doctor, preinstall and every task's own preflight); the Linux container, CI and CONTRIBUTING.md read their package lists and instructions from it.

node.install: Install the version in `.nvmrc` with a version manager: `nvm install` (macOS, Linux), `nvm install $(Get-Content .nvmrc)` (nvm-windows), or Volta, which takes it from `package.json`; or from https://nodejs.org.

rust.install: Install rustup from https://rustup.rs; `npm ci` then installs the toolchain `rust-toolchain.toml` names.

x64.reason: Intel Macs cannot build VniLink: the vendored AV1 and VP8/VP9 build scripts accept only Apple silicon (`vendor/shiguredo-aom/build.rs`, `vendor/shiguredo-libvpx/build.rs`)

arm64.reason: Windows on Arm has no GNU (MinGW) build of the native addon
it builds in the Linux container on Apple silicon but has not run on an arm64 desktop

debian.name: Ubuntu and Debian
debian.verified: Debian 13 (the Linux test container) and Ubuntu 26.04; CI runs Ubuntu 24.04

desktops.reason: Screen capture and input go through the XDG desktop portal; only GNOME's has been exercised. Other desktops are unverified.

fix.missing-rustup: Install rustup from https://rustup.rs, then run `rustup toolchain install` in the checkout.

rust-windows-target.title: Rust GNU Windows target
rust-windows-target.purpose: The addon builds for x86_64-pc-windows-gnu with MSYS2's MinGW, not MSVC.

fix.default: `rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` (`npm ci` does this)

rust-windows-host.title: Rust host toolchain without MSVC
rust-windows-host.purpose: Build scripts run on the host toolchain: a GNU host needs only MinGW, an MSVC host also needs Visual Studio's linker.

fix.default: `rustup set default-host x86_64-pc-windows-gnu`, then `rustup toolchain install`

xcode-tools.title: Xcode Command Line Tools
xcode-tools.purpose: Clang, the SDK and the system frameworks the addon links.

xcode.title: Xcode (actool)
xcode.purpose: Compiles the Icon Composer icon of the development app; without it the flat icon is used.

fix.default: Install Xcode from the App Store, then `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app`.

liquid-glass.title: Liquid Glass prebuild (@vnilink/elg)
liquid-glass.purpose: The optional npm dependency the main process loads for window material.

mingw.title: MSYS2 MinGW-w64 tools
mingw.purpose: Links the addon and builds its C dependencies (gcc, dlltool, libclang, nasm, mingw32-make).

fix.default: `winget install MSYS2.MSYS2`, then in the MSYS2 shell `pacman -S --needed {msys2}`. Put `C:\msys64\mingw64\bin` on PATH or set `VNILINK_MSYS_ROOT` to the MSYS2 root.

git.title: git
git.purpose: The first native build clones codec sources, check:hygiene lists the repository's files, and the VS Code import reads the upstream checkout's commit.

curl.title: curl
curl.purpose: The first native build downloads codec and CMake sources with it.

cmake.title: CMake
cmake.purpose: Builds Opus for the audio codec (opusic-sys); the AV1 build downloads its own CMake.

cmake.win32: `pacman -S mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake` in the MSYS2 shell, or `winget install Kitware.CMake`

linux-build-tools.title: C toolchain, make, pkg-config, nasm, perl
linux-build-tools.purpose: Builds libvpx and libaom from source and links the addon.

process-tools.title: ps
process-tools.purpose: The test suites list the processes a shell started to check that each one ends.

libclang.title: libclang
libclang.purpose: bindgen generates the PipeWire, VA-API and V4L2 bindings with it.

linux-build-libraries.title: Development libraries
linux-build-libraries.purpose: Headers and link libraries of the system services the addon uses.

linux-runtime-libraries.title: Electron runtime libraries
linux-runtime-libraries.purpose: Shared libraries Electron and the addon load at startup.

desktop-session.title: Desktop session
desktop-session.purpose: The application opens windows on an X11 or Wayland display.

fix.default: Run it from a graphical session (`DISPLAY` or `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` set).

secret-service.title: Secret Service
secret-service.purpose: Normal startup reads the installation key from the desktop's Secret Service (org.freedesktop.secrets).

fix.default: Install and unlock a Secret Service provider such as GNOME Keyring or KeePassXC.

test-display.title: Display for UI tests
test-display.purpose: UI tests use the desktop's display; without one, scripts/test.sh runs them under Xvfb with a window manager and a temporary keyring.

linux-sandbox.title: Chromium sandbox
linux-sandbox.purpose: Where AppArmor restricts unprivileged user namespaces (Ubuntu 23.10 and later), the development Electron needs a profile allowing them.

fix.default: `npm run sandbox:linux` (asks for sudo, once per checkout)

apparmor.title: AppArmor
apparmor.purpose: sandbox:linux installs an AppArmor profile with apparmor_parser and sudo.

docker.title: Docker
docker.purpose: Runs the maintained Debian container for Linux validation and network measurements.

fix.darwin: Install and start Docker Desktop: https://docs.docker.com/desktop/
fix.win32: Install and start Docker Desktop: https://docs.docker.com/desktop/
fix.debian: `sudo apt-get install docker.io && sudo usermod -aG docker $USER`, then log in again.
fix.fedora: `sudo dnf install moby-engine && sudo systemctl enable --now docker && sudo usermod -aG docker $USER`, then log in again.

network-namespaces.title: ip and tc
network-namespaces.purpose: The impaired-network harness builds network namespaces and shapes their links.

rsvg-convert.title: rsvg-convert
rsvg-convert.purpose: Renders the tray icons from their SVG sources.

rpmbuild.title: rpmbuild
rpmbuild.purpose: electron-builder builds the .rpm installer with it.

ffmpeg.title: FFmpeg
ffmpeg.purpose: Scores the sharpness of the test card in every perceived-quality run.

root.title: Root
root.purpose: The impaired-network harness creates network namespaces and shapes their links.

fix.default: Run it as root (`sudo node build/run.ts measure:impaired:linux`), or run `npm run measure:impaired`, which runs it in a container.

screen-recording.title: Screen Recording for the application running the task
screen-recording.purpose: The perceived-quality driver captures the display as the application that started the task, a terminal or an editor.

fix.default: Allow that application in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, then quit and reopen it.

accessibility.title: Accessibility for the application running the task
accessibility.purpose: The perceived-quality driver moves the pointer and types with Core Graphics events, which macOS delivers only from an application allowed to control the computer.

fix.default: Allow that application in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.

vnilink-screen-recording.title: Screen Recording for the development VniLink
vnilink-screen-recording.purpose: The latency harness's host and reader capture the display as the development VniLink in `.build/electron`, which macOS asks about by its own identity.

fix.default: Run the task; on its first run macOS asks and the run stops. Allow VniLink in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, then run it again.

screen-portal.title: Screen sharing through the desktop portal
screen-portal.purpose: The latency harness's host and reader share the display through the XDG desktop portal, which asks someone at this computer.

fix.default: Run the task in the graphical session and choose the display in both portal dialogs; the answers are kept in `.build/latency` for later runs.

signed-in-desktop.title: Signed-in desktop
signed-in-desktop.purpose: Desktop Duplication captures only the desktop of the signed-in user, which a process started over SSH or as a service is not in.

fix.default: Run the task from a terminal on the signed-in desktop.

second-computer.title: A second computer
second-computer.purpose: Every task runs on this computer. `--peer` runs a suite or a measurement's other side against `node build/run.ts testkit:agent` on a second computer built from the same commit, where a person approves this computer by its digits.

build.description: Build the native addon and the application

dev.description: Launch the development application with watchers

watch.description: Run the watchers without the application

test:ui.description: Run the UI scenarios in Electron

test:service.description: Run one service's functional suite on this computer

bench:service.description: Measure one service's performance on this computer

testkit:agent.description: Serve suites and measurements run with --peer on another computer

testkit:launch.description: Start a measurement's side for the test agent

test:linux.description: Run the checks and tests in the Linux container

sandbox:linux.description: Allow the development Electron its sandbox

measure:impaired.description: Measure sessions over impaired networks in the container

measure:impaired:linux.description: Measure sessions over impaired networks on this Linux host

measure:latency.description: Measure glass-to-glass latency on this computer

measure:perceived.description: Measure what this Mac shows and how fast it answers input

check:upstream.description: Check the copied VS Code sources

check:hygiene.description: Reject personal details in the repository

doctor.description: Report what every task needs here

docs:prerequisites.description: Write the setup section of CONTRIBUTING.md

downloads.what: libvpx and libaom prebuilt archives from github.com/shiguredo
libvpx prebuilt archive from github.com/shiguredo and the libaom sources from aomedia.googlesource.com
the libvpx and libaom sources from chromium.googlesource.com and aomedia.googlesource.com
